description: Fix SVG logo rendering in Typst - replace inline SVG bytes approach with external SVG file reference to correctly display the thermometer logo.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Presupuesto/logo-smarttemp.svg with the thermometer graphic (blue rounded background, white stroke thermometer, red mercury fill, white scale lines)
Update propuesta-smarttemp.typ to remove the inline SVG raw block and image(bytes(...)) approach
Replace thermo-logo and thermo-logo-large functions to use image("logo-smarttemp.svg") with appropriate sizing
Verify compilation with typst compile propuesta-smarttemp.typ propuesta-smarttemp.pdf
acceptance_criteria: logo-smarttemp.svg exists and contains a valid SVG thermometer graphic with blue background
propuesta-smarttemp.typ uses image("logo-smarttemp.svg") instead of image(bytes(...))
The logo renders correctly at both 80pt (cover) and 32pt (header) sizes
findings: The inline SVG bytes approach (image(bytes(...))) does not work for SVG rendering in Typst 0.15.1. Using an external SVG file with image("logo-smarttemp.svg") works correctly. The SVG includes the blue rounded background (#29b6f6) directly in the file, so no wrapping box with fill is needed in Typst. Compilation produces no errors (only the expected Segoe UI font warning).
